explanationPlan.plainAnswer: AlphaGenome Atlas lets researchers look up predicted effects for a huge set of DNA changes, then choose which candidates deserve laboratory testing.
explanationPlan.workedCase: A DNM1 DNA change rises to the top of a rare-epilepsy research list; researchers check nearby letters in laboratory-grown cells.
explanationPlan.transferCase: For any health-AI score, distinguish a lead for research from proof it can answer a person’s care question.
explanationPlan.usefulAction: Ask what was predicted, what experiment followed, and what must happen before it could inform care.
